title: Emerging Profit-Pool Cross-Holdout Summary V1

cases.name: 中国铝业
cases.label: known_cycle
cases.note: Long suspension made 20/60/120 executable exits collapse to the same later reopening date; interpret cautiously.

windows.contaminationGuard: second window preregistered before 2017 outcome; 2019Q3-Q4 excluded

emerging_pool.warning: Mean/median are dominated by one extreme Hudian winner and are not statistically reliable.

known_cycle_shadow.warning: One case has suspension timing distortion; shadow outcomes are diagnostic, not portfolio returns.

conclusions.strongestSupportedStatement: A newly material profit pool can surface major opportunities, but novelty alone does not discriminate quality. Direct operating conversion, repeatability/duration, cash economics, and expectation burden remain necessary.
examples: Hudian: emerging 5G pool + pre-event reported profit/cash conversion + batch-delivery readiness + limited short-term absorption -> strong success.
Xianhe: emerging monitoring pool + very large single contract, but high valuation and lumpy government-project execution/cash economics -> failure.
Air China: not an emerging pool, but direct large FX sensitivity plus low price absorption -> success.
Minhe: heavily absorbed known cycle still produced positive 60d excess, although with large drawdown -> hard crowdedness exclusion would destroy recall.

productionDecision: Do not add an emerging-profit-pool hard gate or promotion bonus to the production Skill yet.
